# gt Marks

gt Marks

## Usage

``` r
gt_marks(gt_tbl, cols)
```

## Arguments

- gt_tbl:

  A `<gt_tbl>` object

- cols:

  columns to target

## Value

A `<gt_tbl>` object with marks

## Examples

``` r
dplyr::tibble(pass = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt_marks(cols = pass)


  

pass
```
